content:
What kind of engine and what problem?

Give me:
- Engine make/model/year
- Outboard / inboard / sterndrive / diesel / gas
- What it’s doing:
  - won’t start
  - cranks but won’t fire
  - starts then dies
  - runs rough
  - overheats
  - no power
  - alarm/beeping
  - smoke
- Any recent work done
- If it’s getting fuel/spark
- Photos if possible

Quick safe checks first:
- Battery charged and terminals clean/tight
- Kill switch lanyard attached
- Fuel in tank, vent open, primer bulb firm
- Gear in neutral
- Fuses/breakers okay
- Engine oil level okay
- Cooling water intake not blocked

Basic troubleshooting:
1. No crank
- Check battery voltage
- Clean/tighten terminals
- Check neutral safety switch
- Check starter relay/fuse

2. Cranks, won’t start
- Check spark
- Check fuel delivery
- Make sure choke/enrichment works
- On older fuel: drain and replace

3. Starts then dies
- Fuel vent blocked
- Clogged fuel filter
- Bad idle setting / dirty carb
- Weak fuel pump

4. Overheating
- Check telltale/water flow
- Inspect impeller
- Clear intake blockage
- Check thermostat

5. Runs rough / lacks power
- Bad plugs
- Water in fuel
- Dirty carb/injectors
- Compression issue

Important:
- Don’t keep cranking endlessly
- Don’t run without cooling water
- If fuel is leaking, stop immediately
- If it seized, knocks loudly, or has no compression, get a marine mechanic

If you send the engine details and symptoms, I can help you diagnose it step by step.
